title: FOOTBALL | Amaree Williams & Marcus Williams Press Conference - 11/21/26
text: Really about you guys it just felt like there was a lot of bend but don't break today. I mean they had the one touchdown drive but it just felt like every time they got in the red zone you guys kind of tightened up. What was it like in the huddle uh in those situations where they were kind of in the shadow of your own goal post? >> Yeah I mean that's just what we preach all the time you know like on defense here and there they're going to get some yards but ultimately you don't want to let them get in the end zone so that's what we're preaching every week every day in practice you know keep them out the box. >> Perfectly said um yeah just just having the mindset next play type mindset so. >> Questions? We got right here. >> Marcus is obviously an experienced quarterback uh for them and it seemed like he was maybe settling on a few things but what what were you guys planning on doing you know on the the plan of attack for a defense and maybe forcing him to settle for things underneath? >> Yeah just trying to make sure he's seeing different things out there uh not getting too comfortable you know giving them different things up front getting them different things in the back end uh just to make sure he's always on always on ten and not able to just be comfortable and make those easy throws. >> Sam or James? >> Amari how good does it feel to just have the losing streak over and not have to think or hear about it anymore? >> Um you know it's like I said not taking anything away from the win but how I feel is you know we were supposed to win this game um and you know we're on to the next week and you know that's just our mindset about it so. >> Amari you guys had ten tackles for a loss I think you took about 42 yards away from them just what did it take to be able to consistently break the break and win the line of scrimmage on your end? >> Um you know just getting after it um play to play just it's you know 11 as one everybody does their job I mean we're going to get the quarterback and end in the backfield. So, um you know, just having a group of guys that, you know, have the same mindset and same get to. >> I have two. We'll start with Amari. Uh it seems like we never know what you're going to line up. Um I know that's kind of part of the package, but last year you were tight end DE and but you've been a little bit of everything this year on defense. What's it been like kind of embracing that role where you're kind of a rover in some respects? >> Um you know, like like you said, you know, just um being able to just embrace that role. Um coach Arnett does a, you know, amazing job of, you know, using his players. Um for for me personally at that, you know, jack spot, um you know, we're all over the field in coverage, rushing in the run game. So, um you know, it's something that, you know, coming into the season I knew that I was going to have a lot on me and and you know, I've I've stepped up to that. >> And Marcus, I asked other guys too like you win and you're in, right? You win one, you earn another game. So, what's kind of the mindset going into rivalry week for this for this defense knowing what's at stake? >> Yeah, the same mindset as every other week, you know, we're going to attack the preparation. Uh and then by the time Friday Friday at 11:00 rolls around, we should be able to execute what we practiced. Uh as far as the rivalry, I mean, this is my first time being a part of this rivalry, so I'm really amped up, really excited to see what it's all about and and come home with that trophy. >> Anything else? For both of you, um when you were able to come off the field and watch the offense put up points like they did back in the season was was young and everything was looking great. How fun was it to see them score fast and far once again? >> Yeah, I mean, it's always great to see when your offense is putting up points and your defense going out there getting stops. I think that's just good complementary football. >> Yeah, I mean, yeah, he said it perfect, you know, just having a you know, I there's really not much to add, just complementary football. Um getting off the field and you know, them and able to get off the field too. So, um you know, it's a you know, complimentary football, like I said. >> Marcus, you were one of the seniors that walked today. Just what was that experience like for you to go out and meet your family and everything and uh just how did that feel? >> Uh it felt great. Uh woke up this morning a little bit emotional just kind of just thinking about all the all the years before, but you know, it felt good being you know, my my people were here. I got to see them before after the game. So, yeah, a good experience. >> All right. >> Thank you all.
